Eye Pattern - Glasslike Eyes.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Glasslike Eyes
Irises with a transparent, glass-like quality — as if the eyes were made from blown glass rather than organic tissue.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Glasslike Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Both irises have a smooth translucent glasslike quality — the color is vivid and clear, like looking into tinted glass rather than a living eye. Apply glasslike translucent iris finish using selected eye colors. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
